example_complete.description: Complete example with all optional fields

example_alternative_u_values.description: Example using direct U-value keys instead of nested object

required.area: Heated floor area per floor in square meters (m²). Must be positive.
required.N_f: Number of floors. Must be a positive integer.
required.year: Construction year. Determines air change rate: >=1995: 0.25, 1977-1994: 0.5, <1977: 1.0
required.postal_code: Postal code for design temperature lookup. Can also use 'postcode'.

optional.n_walls_touching: Number of walls touching other buildings (total across all floors). Default: 0
optional.u_values: U-values object with keys: floor, wall, roof, window. Defaults: 0.3, 0.4, 0.25, 1.2
optional.U_floor: Alternative: Direct U-value for floor. Default: 0.3
optional.U_wall: Alternative: Direct U-value for wall. Default: 0.4
optional.U_roof: Alternative: Direct U-value for roof. Default: 0.25
optional.U_window: Alternative: Direct U-value for window. Default: 1.2
optional.h: Height of each floor in meters (m). Default: 2.5
optional.f_wall: Correction factor for wall exposed to air. Default: 1.0
optional.f_wall_touching: Correction factor for walls touching other buildings. Default: 0.5
optional.t_indoor: Indoor design temperature in Celsius (°C). Default: 21.0
optional.is_ground_floor: Whether building has ground floor. Default: true
optional.is_top_floor: Whether building has top floor. Default: true
